text:
maria-marketing: Quick sync — planning to announce the Adaptive Batching release next Wed 10:00am PT. Need final changelog, docs link, benchmark blurb for the webinar, and lead-routing rules. T-minus 3 days. :rocket:
ashok-docs: Working on the docs PR now. Where should I point the "changelog" link? draft or prod?
kevin-eng: Changelog draft is live: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/412 (short summary below). We can push final at 9:30 PT day-of.
kevin-eng: Changelog TL;DR: "Adaptive batching cuts median token latency by ~12% and reduces token cost ~18% for conversational workloads (LLM-optimizations v2)."
olivia-growth: Webinar proposal: run a 30-min launch talk Thurs following the announce (Thu 11am PT). Need a 3-sentence benchmark blurb + 2 graphs (latency vs qps, cost per 1k tokens). Who can hand those off?
sam-sales: For inbound routing please tag leads with campaign=adaptive-batching and urgency=announce. Also we prefer a high-touch routing to AE queue for customers with >$10k ARR. Can we add a hidden form param or utm?
ashok-docs: I'll wire the docs PR to the changelog. Final docs URL will be https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/adaptive-batching once deployed. Will include a short "what changed" banner and a quickstart snippet.
maria-marketing: Sample announcement copy (choose one):
- Short social: "Adaptive Batching is live — faster responses, lower token costs. Read the measurements + how to enable: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/adaptive-batching :rocket:"
- Email subject: "Adaptive Batching: lower latency & cost for production LLMs"
- LinkedIn: "We shipped Adaptive Batching — engineered to reduce latency and cost for real production traffic. Benchmark highlights + migration notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/adaptive-batching"
maria-marketing: Who's owning social scheduling, docs deploy, and canary rollout? I'll own social + email. @ashok-docs you own docs deploy. @kevin-eng you own rollout and telemetry checks. @olivia-growth webinar ops. @sam-sales lead routing.
kevin-eng: Rollout plan snippet (we'll trigger via deploy-bot):
```
2026-03-25 10:00 PT: public announce (press + social)
10:00-10:20: canary ~10% traffic -> sanity checks
10:20-10:40: expand to 50% if no errors
10:40-11:00: 100%
11:00: metric snapshot + callout to monitoring channel
```
kevin-eng: Deploy-bot will post status in #eng-releases. If 5xx > 0.5% we rollback to previous model variant.
ashok-docs: Docs checklist: short intro, config flag example, migration notes, compatibility table, link to benchmarks, changelog anchor. I'll add the two graphs Olivia needs — need the raw CSVs. @kevin-eng can you drop CSVs here?
kevin-eng: Dropping CSVs: https://internal-storage/redwood/benchmarks/adaptive-batching/graphs.zip (latency_by_qps.csv, cost_by_tokens.csv). Use for webinar slides.
olivia-growth: Great — I'll build the slides and a 3-sentence benchmark blurb: "On our conversational benchmark, Adaptive Batching reduces median latency by ~12% and average per-token cost by ~18%, with most gains seen at 20–200 QPS."
sam-sales: For routing: we'll map campaign=adaptive-batching -> utm_campaign=adaptive-batching, add tag lead_source=announce, and if company_size>1000 then route to AE_high_touch. Also can you include a short FAQ in the email for reps?
maria-marketing: I'll draft the email FAQ (2 bullets: enablement steps, migration impact). Plan for final asset delivery schedule:
- Today by EOD: docs PR open and graphs attached (ashok + kevin)
- Tomorrow by noon: final webinar slides and copy (olivia + maria)
- Day of by 9:30 PT: final changelog, docs prod link, and routing config (kevin + ashok + sam)
- Day of 10:00 PT: announce live
ashok-docs: ACK. I'll merge docs PR after CI and coordinate with deploy-bot to swap docs.live at 9:45 PT.
kevin-eng: ACK. I'll watch telemetry and ping #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
olivia-growth: RSVP for speakers: Kevin (eng deep dive), Maria (product story), Olivia (benchmarks). I'll create calendar invites once slides land.
sam-sales: I'll post routing rules to the CRM config doc and share the form snippet.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job created: release/adaptive-batching -> canary at 2026-03-25T17:00:00Z (ties to planned window). Status updates will post automatically.
maria-marketing: Perfect — I'll assemble final announce bundle and ping growth/sales channels once everything is green. If anything slips, call for a 8:30am PT sync day-of. :thumbsup:
